stances.name: archival
stances.description: MoMA catalogs, Rijksmuseum. Numbered sections, serif/mono pairings, textured neutrals, reverent composition.

stances.name: brutalist
stances.description: Bloomberg Businessweek online, brutalistwebsites.com. Raw mono type, stark black/white, hot accent, deliberately unstyled-looking but composed.

stances.name: data-dense
stances.description: Bloomberg Terminal, FlightRadar. Small tabular fonts, maximum information density, functional color coding, little whitespace.

stances.name: editorial
stances.description: Monocle, The Gentlewoman, Kinfolk. Serif display + sans body, asymmetric column grids, generous margins, feature photography, warm neutral palettes.

stances.name: kinetic
stances.description: Pentagram motion reels, Apple product reveals. Motion is primary; often dark with light motion highlights.

stances.name: maximalist
stances.description: Zine aesthetic, scrap-and-tape. Mixed type, overlapping elements, deliberately layered hierarchy.

stances.name: memphis
stances.description: Ettore Sottsass. Geometric shapes on pastels, primary accents, asymmetric, playful without childish.

stances.name: minimalist
stances.description: Apple, Aesop, Teenage Engineering product pages. One hero element, tight type, lots of whitespace, single accent.

stances.name: swiss
stances.description: Vignelli, Jost Hochuli, Helvetica. Strict grid, mostly neutrals plus one accent, precise alignment, function declares the aesthetic.

stances.name: warm
stances.description: Aesop, Le Labo, boutique hospitality. Cream bases, muted earth tones, serif type, tactile-feeling imagery.

stances.name: risograph
stances.description: Riso zine printing, People of Print. Two-ink overprint, visible grain, slight misregistration, flat saturated spot colors on uncoated stock.

stances.name: terminal
stances.description: tmux dashboards, btop, Berkeley Graphics. Monospace everything, box-drawing rules, one phosphor accent on near-black, the information is the interface.

stances.name: bauhaus
stances.description: Bauhaus Dessau, Braun under Rams. Primary geometry, grid-locked composition, functional color blocking, zero ornament.

stances.name: y2k-web
stances.description: Frutiger Aero, early-2000s consumer web. Glossy depth, aqua gradients, rounded chrome, technological optimism.

stances.name: luxury-fashion
stances.description: Céline campaigns, The Row lookbooks. Extreme whitespace, Didone display, monochrome photography, hairline everything.

stances.name: deco
stances.description: Art Deco poster lithography, hotel signage. Stepped geometry, metallic accents, symmetry, vertical emphasis.

stances.name: vernacular
stances.description: Hand-painted shop signs, county-fair flyers. Loud type mixing, decorative borders, honest clutter, unpolished warmth.

stances.name: topographic
stances.description: USGS quadrangles, Swiss hiking maps, NASA mission graphics. Contour lines, coordinate grids, annotation typography, terrain palettes.

typographyTraditions.name: Blackletter / gothic
typographyTraditions.examples: Fraktur derivatives, Cloister, Wilhelm Klingspor Gotisch

typographyTraditions.name: Condensed / expressive display
typographyTraditions.examples: Druk, PP Right Grotesk, Founders Grotesk Condensed

typographyTraditions.name: Didone / high-contrast serif
typographyTraditions.examples: Bodoni, Didot, Noe Display, GT Sectra lineage

typographyTraditions.name: Monospace-as-display
typographyTraditions.examples: JetBrains Mono, Berkeley Mono, Fira Code

typographyTraditions.name: Script / calligraphic
typographyTraditions.examples: Didot Italic swashes, formal cursive — use sparingly
